people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.
translations.bsb: At that time Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army said to Abraham, “God is with you in all that you do.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
